c74object.name: evi_logahr
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Attack/hold/release envelope follower
c74object.description:
evi_logahr is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
Logarithmic attack/hold/release envelope follower / smoother.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ value, attack, hold, release } }

geninlet.name: value
geninlet.digest: to Follow. evi_logahr will follow this input value with the given attack, hold and release times.

geninlet.name: attack
geninlet.digest: Time in milliseconds @min 0. Amount of time the envelope takes to attack. evi_logahr is logarithmic and does not attack in this time exactly.

geninlet.name: hold
geninlet.digest: Time in milliseconds @min 0. Amount of time to hold the envelope after the attack stage and before the release stage (in milliseconds).

geninlet.name: release
geninlet.digest: Time in milliseconds @min 0. Amount of time the envelope takes to release. evi_logahr is logarithmic and does not release in this time exactly.
